guide-documents.title: Hajj & Umrah Documents and Visa Guide | Sada-e-Rehmat
guide-documents.desc: A practical Hajj and Umrah documents guide covering passports, identity information, visas, booking questions, and a calm preparation checklist.
guide-documents.h1: Documents, passports & visas: a calm preparation guide
guide-documents.intro: The paperwork can feel like the most stressful part of pilgrimage planning. A clear order of tasks makes it much easier to see what you have, what is missing, and what to ask before paying a deposit.

guide-first-umrah.title: Your First Umrah: Step-by-Step Planning Guide | Sada-e-Rehmat
guide-first-umrah.desc: A practical first Umrah guide covering preparation, Ihram, the rites, rest, group planning, and questions to ask your travel team.
guide-first-umrah.h1: Your first Umrah: what to expect and how to prepare
guide-first-umrah.intro: Your first Umrah should feel spiritually meaningful, not like a race through a checklist. Good preparation gives you the space to focus on worship, your companions, and the moments you will remember.

guide-packing.title: What to Pack for Hajj or Umrah | Sada-e-Rehmat
guide-packing.desc: A useful Hajj and Umrah packing list for pilgrims travelling from Pakistan, the UK, and beyond, with practical advice for heat, walking, documents, and comfort.
guide-packing.h1: What to pack for Hajj or Umrah without overpacking
guide-packing.intro: The best packing list is not the longest one. It is the list that helps you walk comfortably, stay organised, manage the heat, and keep essential documents and medication close at hand.

guide-health.title: Hajj and Umrah Health, Heat and Vaccine Guide | Sada-e-Rehmat
guide-health.desc: A practical Hajj and Umrah health guide covering ACWY vaccination advice, medication, heat, hydration, walking, and current official travel guidance.
guide-health.h1: Health, heat & vaccinations: prepare your body for the journey
guide-health.intro: Pilgrimage can involve heat, crowds, long walks, altered sleep, and a demanding daily rhythm. A little preparation before departure can make it easier to stay well and ask for help early.

guide-choosing.title: How to Compare Hajj and Umrah Packages | Sada-e-Rehmat
guide-choosing.desc: A detailed guide to comparing Hajj and Umrah packages, including hotels, transfers, visas, meals, Ziyarat, group support, protections, and written terms.
guide-choosing.h1: How to compare pilgrimage packages with confidence
guide-choosing.intro: A lower headline price does not always mean better value. The right comparison looks at what is included, how clearly it is confirmed, and how well the package fits the needs of your group.

guide-safety.title: Hajj and Umrah Scam Awareness and Travel Safety Guide | Sada-e-Rehmat
guide-safety.desc: A Hajj and Umrah safety guide covering scam awareness, payment records, documents, group communication, and how to plan with confidence.
guide-safety.h1: Avoiding scams and surprises when booking pilgrimage travel
guide-safety.intro: Most pilgrims are focused on the spiritual journey, which can make urgent offers or emotional pressure feel persuasive. A few calm checks can protect your money, your documents, and your peace of mind.
